messages:
maya: Quick ping — PR #46291 is ready for review. It wires fallback routing to quant-int8 model + canary flag. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before merge. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/46291
sam: looking now, can you paste the canary plan here?
jordan: pinging @runtime-team and @eng-infra for perf/eviction concerns :eyes:
maya: canary plan (summary): 1) merge with canary flag OFF, 2) enable canary for 2 instances in canary pool, 3) monitor latency/cost and errors for 30m, 4) rollback if tail latency +5% or error rate >0.5%
maya: canary config snippet:
```yaml
feature_flags:
  routing_fallback_canary: false
  canary_pool: small-gpu
```
sam: quick question — fallback model is quant-int8, does that change kv-cache key shape or serialization?
leo: runtime: it touches kv key format for compressed weights. We'll need a tiny migration shim. I'll add a patch to the PR today.
jordan: infra: eviction/window config looks fine but callout — prefetch TTL reduced to 45s may increase churn. Recommend monitoring LRU evictions.
infra-bot: heads-up: scheduled canary window slot requested for 2024-11-06T16:00Z. Please update when ready.
tess: security quick pass: auth/data paths look good. Add an explicit KMS audit-log check in the PR (one-liner).
maya: thanks — I'll add the migration shim + audit-log check. Who can take final LGTM after those small commits?
sam: I can +1 runtime after the migration shim lands.
jordan: infra +1 from me once the monitoring hook is added to the canary dashboard.
tess: sec +1 after audit-log verification (I'll sign off).
maya: will push the two small commits in ~30m and aim for merge window tomorrow 09:00 PT. Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
